label: Southern Spear Strikes / Killed
source: Fox News, Stars and Stripes, Military.com, Wikipedia, Associated Press, Al Jazeera, CBS News, Human Rights Watch, The Intercept, Seapower Magazine
contestNote: CNN reporting questions the campaign's effectiveness at reducing trafficking; rights groups dispute the legality of strikes without capture or trial. Sen. Tim Kaine says classified intel shows strikes have likely killed people uninvolved in trafficking, calling them 'murder victims'; Pentagon IG is reviewing targeting procedures. 2 Sep 2026 one-year-anniversary reports (HRW, The Intercept) find only 26 of 227 victims (11%) publicly named and none formally charged. House Armed Services ranking member Adam Smith (2 Sep 2026) calls the administration's transparency on the campaign the worst he's seen in 20+ years on the committee. Families of 28 Ecuadorian crew from three fishing boats sunk as alleged 'refueling stations' (28 Aug-3 Sep 2026) dispute the narco-trafficking characterization; no charges filed.
delta: JTF-WHEM's first lethal strike since 25 August killed 3 in the Caribbean on 9 Sep 2026, ending a roughly two-week run of six non-lethal refueling-vessel interdictions (28 Aug-8 Sep) off Ecuador.
